theorem symdiff_count (src other : GMap w64 Unit) (keys : List w64) (Hkset : ∀ (k : w64), k ∈ keys ↔
    (src !! k).isSome = true) (Hnd : keys.Nodup) : (List.filter (fun k => !(other !! k).isSome)
    keys).length = (src \ other).size

theorem symdiff_take_succ (other : GMap w64 Unit) (keys : List w64) (i : Int) (key : w64) (Hi : 0 ≤
    i) (Hkey : keys[i.toNat]? = some key) : (List.filter (fun k => !(other !! k).isSome) (List.take
    (i + 1).toNat keys)).length = (List.filter (fun k => !(other !! k).isSome) (List.take i.toNat
    keys)).length + if (other !! key).isSome = true then 0 else 1
